offers.title: What I build
offers.subtitle: Five ways to work together, from one workflow to a full operating system.

items.d: Fully customized Notion workspaces for startups and SMBs: CRM, HR, company wikis. Your processes in a bilingual (Arabic & English) environment.

Custom instructions, playbooks and data access that turn Notion AI into a teammate who knows your context.
Process analysis before building, and interactive training for Arab teams after launch.

items.q: Do you build custom systems only?
items.a: No. I also have ready-made templates if you want something to start with quickly. This service is for systems tailored to how you work.

items.q: Do I need a paid review first?
items.a: No, not necessarily. A clearly defined project can go straight to a proposal. The review is for when the work is still unclear, and its fee is deducted in full if you book a project within 30 days.
Timelines vary by complexity, but most projects take 2 to 4 weeks from design to delivery.
Every build includes training, documentation and 30 days to report and correct defects in the agreed deliverables.
Yes. I work with individuals, companies and teams, from one person organizing their work to a business running several departments in one workspace.

items.q: Can the system be in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Systems can be fully Arabic, English, or bilingual, and I train Arab teams in their own language.
